title_zh: 约定先测试打印设置再判断故障

scenario.label_zh: 约定先测试打印设置再判断故障
scenario.goal_zh: 说明打印机反复恢复彩色设置，并约定核对默认配置、测试后回报结果，若问题仍出现则进一步调查

context_zh: 虚构设备支持电话：用户询问共享办公室打印机的设置问题。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: The printer continually switches back to colour even after I select black and white.

sentences.speaker: Support agent
sentences.text: Is colour still the default in your saved printer profile?

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: I don't know. I only change the setting in the print window.

sentences.speaker: Support agent
sentences.text: That may explain it, but it could also be a software defect. Let us check the saved configuration before deciding.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: I can open the profile after this call. What result do you need?

sentences.speaker: Support agent
sentences.text: Set black and white as the saved choice, print one test page, then reopen the print window. Tell us whether the choice has stayed the same.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: I'll try that with a blank test document and send you the result. If it reverts again, please investigate further.

sentences.speaker: Support agent
sentences.text: We will. I have added those test steps to your support ticket.
